events.title: Marriage
events.description: Recently married? Here are the government schemes and documents you should know about.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Samoohik Vivah Yojana
schemes.description: UP government provides Rs 51,000 assistance for mass wedding ceremonies for economically weak families.
schemes.eligibility: Family income below Rs 2 lakh. Bride must be 18+, groom 21+.

schemes.name: Update Ration Card
schemes.description: Add spouse's name to family ration card after marriage.
schemes.action: Visit CSC or Tehsil with marriage certificate

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
schemes.description: If homeless, apply for PMAY housing assistance.
schemes.eligibility: No pucca house, income below Rs 3 lakh/year

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.description: If no LPG connection, new wife can apply for free LPG connection.
schemes.eligibility: BPL household, no existing LPG connection

events.title: Newborn / New Baby
events.description: Congratulations! Here are the essential schemes and steps for your newborn.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
schemes.description: Cash incentive for institutional delivery. Rs 1,400 in rural areas, Rs 1,000 in urban for BPL mothers.
schemes.eligibility: Pregnant women from BPL families. Delivery at government/accredited hospital.
schemes.action: Apply through ASHA worker or PHC

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.description: Rs 2,000 at birth for girl child. Total Rs 15,000 in 6 stages till graduation.
schemes.eligibility: Girl child born after April 2019, family income < Rs 3 lakh
schemes.action: Apply at mksy.up.gov.in within 6 months of birth

schemes.name: Universal Immunisation Programme
schemes.description: Free vaccines for all children. BCG, Polio, DPT, MMR, and more.
schemes.action: Visit nearest PHC or government hospital

schemes.name: Add to Ration Card
schemes.description: Add newborn's name to family ration card for additional food entitlement.
schemes.eligibility: All families with PDS ration card
schemes.action: Visit CSC or Tehsil within 1 year of birth

events.title: Senior Citizen (60+)
events.description: Turning 60 or caring for an elderly family member? Know your entitlements.

schemes.name: UP Old Age Pension (Vridhavastha Pension)
schemes.description: Rs 500/month for senior citizens from BPL families above 60 years.
schemes.eligibility: Age 60+, UP resident, annual income < Rs 46,080
schemes.action: Apply at Block Office or sspy-up.gov.in

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY)
schemes.description: Rs 5 lakh annual health insurance for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
schemes.action: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or nearest CSC

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
schemes.description: Free assistive devices (walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids) for BPL seniors with disability.
schemes.action: Apply through ALIMCO or District Social Welfare Office

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Railway Concession
schemes.description: 40% discount for men 60+ and 50% for women 60+ on Indian Railways.
schemes.action: Book tickets at IRCTC showing age proof

schemes.name: AAY / Priority Ration Card
schemes.description: Senior citizens without income may qualify for AAY (35 kg/month) or Priority ration card.

documents_needed: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / 10th Certificate)
